example.title: Asian supermarket in a strip-centre anchor (99 Ranch Market)
example.place: San Diego, San Diego County, CA

brief: A 1990s single-storey supermarket anchoring a strip centre: a flat-roofed block of cream and red stucco with a raised square entrance bay carrying a lit round logo and red lettering, a glass front and a car park. One photo (at night). Foundations taken deeper than needed (spec rule 4).
